ThingDef.label: clannfear
ThingDef.description: A medium-sized reptile that has mutated under the influence of unknown factors.

ThingDef.label: Doerd
ThingDef.description: A creature of unknown origin, believed to have undergone severe mutations. Almost the entire body is covered with horny growths and bone formations.

ThingDef.label: shalk
ThingDef.description: A creeping insect, on which you can often find mushrooms growing directly on the shell.

ThingDef.label: alit
ThingDef.description: Large carnivorous reptile that lives in desert lands. It has a strange appearance, which hints at susceptibility to mutations in the past.

ThingDef.label: wormmouth
ThingDef.description: A two-legged creature with an oblong mouth.

ThingDef.label: Foxer
ThingDef.description: Presumably it is a species of fox mutated as a result of the disaster.

ThingDef.label: Butterfly vampire
ThingDef.description: A giant butterfly that feeds on animal meat. Differs in aggressiveness.

ThingDef.label: Arachnoid
ThingDef.description: Large for their species spiders that prey on small animals.

ThingDef.label: eyeling
ThingDef.description: A radioactive life form that lives against all odds.

ThingDef.label: Zion
ThingDef.description: A furry herbivore mutated by radiation. Probably the ancestor of the creature is an ungulate animal, like a cow.

ThingDef.label: Huge spider
ThingDef.description: A large and aggressive spider that feeds on small animals or carcasses.

ThingDef.label: Drake
ThingDef.description: A mutated creature from the radioactive forests. Aggressive and carnivorous. The skin pulsates red.

ThingDef.label: Medvedosov
ThingDef.description: A dangerous creature that looks like a crossbreed of an owl and a bear. Reproduces by laying eggs.

ThingDef.label: Medvedosov egg (unfert.)
ThingDef.description: An unfertilized Medvedosov egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.

ThingDef.label: Medvedosov egg (fert.)
ThingDef.description: A fertilized Medvedosov egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a baby Medvedosov. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

ThingDef.label: beakthing
ThingDef.description: A tall, intimidating animal of unknown origin. Hutter is one of the most dangerous and aggressive creatures known to mankind. And while their ferocity would make them ideal attack animals, these same qualities ensure that they are virtually impossible to tame or farm.

ThingDef.label: gutter egg (fert.)
ThingDef.description: A fertilized gutter egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a beakthing. A sought after delicacy, beakthing eggs are highly valued on the market.

ThingDef.label: leviathan
ThingDef.description: A huge titanic creature, aggressive when attacked.

ThingDef.label: garru
ThingDef.description: A large, muscular herbivore with thick skin and floppy ears.

ThingDef.label: bonegoat
ThingDef.description: A highly mutated variety of domesticated bone goat. Bonebucks have a slower metabolism, a higher threshold for high temperatures, and a bony shell over their heads that provides them with some protection from predators.

ThingDef.label: elephant turtle
ThingDef.description: A large genetically modified soft-shell turtle. Elephant tortoises have prehensile trunks, which they use to manipulate objects and access vegetation.

ThingDef.label: elephant turtle egg (fert.)
ThingDef.description: A fertilized elephant turtle egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into an elephant turtle calf. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

ThingDef.label: giant crab
ThingDef.description: A mutated crab that lives in the red forest. It has a durable shell and powerful claws.

ThingDef.label: Glacius
ThingDef.description: An ancient creature that lived in the region of the poles. Dangerous and deadly.

ThingDef.label: Boommoth
ThingDef.description: An explosive, overgrown moth that cannot fly. It has vestigial wings and feeds on flesh.

ThingDef.label: Crystal worm
ThingDef.description: A large worm with mineral growths on its body.

ThingDef.label: Ikrum
ThingDef.description: An aggressive and completely furred creature, capable of moving quickly and standing on its hind legs when running.

ThingDef.label: Double-headed snail
ThingDef.description: Mutated red forest snail.
